meta.brand: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
meta.notes: Primary green #009600 cross-validated two ways: CSS census (common.css — loader spinner, .cmn-pfbtn platform-button accent, .cmn-section-title marker bar, 9 uses) AND pixel-frequency-sampled from the logo PNG's Delta glyph (5842 of ~5900 green-family pixels are exactly #009600). This is the strongest possible evidence tier. PS5 blue (#0070CC) and Xbox green (#107C10) are platform-badge colours scoped to .cmn-pfbtn.is-ps5/.is-xbox — excluded from the 7-role brand palette as store-flexible/incidental, not brand-locked. statusPositive reuses the brand's own primary green (military status-light convention, observed directly on the Fox Hunt server-status page: green/olive/grey dots for Online/Under maintenance/Down, each paired with a text label — non-colour-alone cue already native to the brand). statusCaution and statusNegative are derived to fit the muted military palette.

essence.positioning: The Beginning of it All — a faithful, next-gen remake of the Cold War espionage classic, rendered with photoreal Unreal Engine 5 fidelity.

voice.source: live copy read from https://www.konami.com/mg/mgs3r/us/en/ and /characters/ via browser
voice.summary: Measured, mission-briefing register — third person, factual, dossier-like character bios; marketing copy is confident but restrained, never exclamatory.

pillars.name: Dossier-style character bios
pillars.evidence: A GRU colonel known in the West by the codename "Thunderbolt." A sadist with a penchant for torture, ultra-high voltage electricity flows through his body, which he unleashes in his attacks.

pillars.name: Legacy-respecting, not oversold
pillars.evidence: Everything you love, and more — The story, characters, voice acting, gameplay, and music that made the original a sensation return, remade for modern consoles.

pillars.name: Technical credibility as a selling point
pillars.evidence: Characters are rendered in such fine detail that facial wrinkles, pores, and even separate eye and iris movements are visible, allowing for rich and emotive facial animations.

pillars.name: Permanence / consequence framing
pillars.evidence: Injuries will leave their mark on Snake's body permanently, telling a story of each player's unique journey through the game.

pillars.name: Understated milestone announcements
pillars.evidence: 2,000,000 COPIES SOLD *As of 2/17/2026, per internal tracking

voice.person: third person throughout; the player is never addressed directly as "you" in narrative copy (only in feature-description copy, e.g. "Players can elect for...")
voice.cadence: measured, declarative sentences; em-dashes for dramatic pause ("a mission that will mark the start of a new legend, against the backdrop of the ever-changing march of history"); no exclamation points; ALL-CAPS reserved for section labels and platform names
voice.commerceVoice: Sales milestones are cited like a field report ("2,000,000 COPIES SOLD *As of 2/17/2026, per internal tracking") rather than promoted; sale/bundle news sits in the same understated News feed as patch notes.

copyExamples.bonusBadge: Includes the METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 Bundle
copyExamples.scarcityBadge: Not used — the brand voice avoids scarcity/urgency framing
copyExamples.errorState: Signal lost — please retry the transmission.

artStyle.subStyle: military-realism Unreal Engine 5 photogrammetry-grade character rendering, jungle/Cold-War-Soviet environmental realism
renderingCues: physically-based skin/cloth shading with visible pore-level detail
volumetric jungle fog and dappled light
battle-damage/wear decals applied in real time on character models
handheld-camera-adjacent framing in key art (motion blur, shallow DOF)

primary.usage: section-title accent bar, platform-button accent, loader spinner, Δ logo glyph — cross-validated CSS + logo pixel sample

secondary.usage: pale lime gradient highlight on inline flourish text

tertiary.usage: solid CTA button background (slightly darker green than the primary accent)

statusPositive.usage: server-status "Online" indicator — reuses brand primary green, paired with a text label (non-colour-alone cue native to the brand)

statusCaution.usage: derived olive-yellow for "Under maintenance" status, consistent with the muted military palette

statusNegative.usage: "Down" status uses grey, not red — observed brand convention avoids alarm-red for routine status

contrastRules: White (#FFFFFF) on Void Black (#080808) ≈ 20:1 — default body/heading pairing
Primary Green (#009600) on Void Black ≈ 5.1:1 — safe for body copy, unlike many brand greens
Pale Lime (#C4E39C) on Void Black ≈ 14.1:1 — safe for body copy
White on solid Green button fill (#007E00 tertiary) ≈ 3.9:1 — borderline; only acceptable at the observed bold/large button sizes (17–22px bold), never for small body text on a green fill
PS5 blue and Xbox green are platform-badge colours only (see storeFlexible note) — do not use as brand accents

families.display: URW DIN Semi-Condensed (headings — .cmn-page-title, buttons) — Google Fonts proxy: Oswald
families.body: Helvetica, Arial, Yu Gothic (CJK fallback), sans-serif — no proxy needed, system-safe

scale.pairingRationale: A condensed grotesque display face reads as stencilled/tactical against a plain Helvetica body — classic military-briefing contrast.

typography.reversedTypeRule: all text is white-on-near-black by default; headings use the condensed display face at 0.07em tracking; never letterspace lowercase body text

heading.sourceArchive: src/stores/mgsdelta/font/ (full URW DIN family OTFs supplied by the user; only Regular+Bold converted to woff2 and wired)
heading.proxyRationale: kept as the CSS fallback (index.html link) in case a woff2 fails to load; no longer the primary face now that the licensed font is local

motifs: thin green accent bar preceding section titles
diagonal-cut button corners on green CTAs (clip-path bevel)

lightingModel.interactiveElements: solid green fill + bold condensed label, subtle bevel on CTA buttons
lightingModel.vfxSignature: volumetric jungle fog, embers/sparks in Fox Hunt key art, shallow depth of field on character portraits

accessibility.largeTextContrast: ≥ 3:1 — white-on-green-button (3.9:1) passes only at the observed bold/large sizes
accessibility.statusNotByColourAlone: the brand's own server-status widget already pairs each colour dot with a text label (Online/Under maintenance/Down) — carry this pattern forward
accessibility.notes: white text on the tertiary green CTA fill is borderline (3.9:1) — flagged; keep CTA labels bold and ≥17px, or darken the green fill for small text

distress.rule: not observed — imagery uses battle damage/wear on character models, not a UI texture layer

noise.note: subtle film grain on key art photography

texture.other: clean flat UI chrome — texture lives in the 3D-rendered imagery, not the interface

assetPrompts.heroBanner: Photoreal Unreal-Engine-5-quality render of a battle-worn special-forces operative in 1960s jungle camouflage, sniper rifle slung, face partially obscured by a bandana, deep jungle fog behind him lit by a single shaft of light, shallow depth of field, cinematic 16:9 key art, desaturated olive-and-black palette with a single vivid green accent.
assetPrompts.skuArt: Portrait 2:3 photoreal render of Cold War military survival gear (camouflage jacket, binoculars, combat knife) laid out on a weathered field map, single hard overcast light, muted olive and near-black palette with one vivid green accent object.
assetPrompts.background: Seamless dark jungle-canopy texture tile, near-black with deep olive-green foliage silhouettes, subtle film grain, very low contrast, for use as a dark webstore section background.

codashop.architectureNote: 5-tier cascade: (1) type primitives + ref seeds → (2) palette ramps (--x-palette-{role}-500 = --x-ref-{role}) → (3) sys intensity / dimensions / effects / states → (4) semantic defaults (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) → (5) .text-style-* classes. THREE override layers: SYSTEM CONSTANT (layoutSystem + the 27 textStyle compositions + scales) ⊃ BRAND-LOCKED (ref seeds, font, size values, brandCharacter) ⊃ STORE-FLEXIBLE (semantic colour mapping, component variants).

layoutSystem.containerRule: device screen sets container-type:inline-size; overlay must NOT (traps position:fixed)

spanVariants.content: full width on XS/S; centred cols 3–10 of 12, max-width 960px, on M/L
spanVariants.carousel: full-bleed on XS/S (negative margin cancels grid margin); content on M/L

layoutSystem.tokenTierDiscipline: components consume ONLY semantic (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) + spacing/size (--x-pad-*, --x-gap-*, --x-radius-*, --x-size-*); NEVER --x-sys-*, --x-palette-*, or --x-ref-* directly
layoutSystem.mobileDesktopRule: values switch at breakpoints via -desktop- token twins

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Diagonal-cut CTA button corner
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: clip-path bevel on one or two corners of the solid green button, observed as a subtle diagonal cut in common.css transform rules (rotate(45deg) pseudo-elements) — approximate with clip-path: polygon(...) trimming ~6px off the top-right corner

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Section-title accent bar
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: a 5px-wide, full-height solid green (#009600) bar positioned to the left of the section title text via ::before — not a token-expressible border, a dedicated decorative element

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Server-status traffic-light widget
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: coloured dot (green/olive/grey) + adjacent text label per platform — reusable pattern for any live-service status display; never colour alone
